text:
Elena (People Ops): Quick mid-cycle checkpoint thread  putting together a short manager playbook + a small FAQ before packet publish tomorrow.
Ravi (Eng Manager): Awesome. Two quick asks: 1) checklist for managers to confirm before upload, 2) clear rule for people who were on leave for >50% of the period.
Elena (People Ops): For managers checklist (short): 1) completed rubric for each direct, 2) evidence binder highlights (3 bullets), 3) context blurb for any adjustment (+1/-1), 4) flag promotion/comp-impact, 5) confirm backups if OOO.
Mei (HRBP): Leave rule: if >50% of period on approved leave, use "limited review" by default. Manager can submit exception if they believe assessment is fair. Exception form required.
Jordan (IC): Will there be a template for the context blurb? Some managers write essays and it slows down calibration reading.
Elena (People Ops): Yes  please keep blurb to 1-2 sentences. Suggested template: "Scope & impact summary (1 sentence). Mitigating factors if any (1 sentence)." Example: "Led rollout of inference autoscaling (reduced queuing by 35%). Returned from parental leave Apr 10 - limited overlap with cycle."
Priya (Comp Ops): On comp-impact flags: please add estimated delta in USD and indicate whether it's base, bonus, or equity-related. We need that for early comp review.
Ravi (Eng Manager): Any changes to timing? My lead asked if we can get a one-day buffer before exec packet goes out.
Elena (People Ops): Timeline unchanged: self-assessments due Thu 05/05 23:59 PT, manager uploads due Thu 05/12 17:00 PT, calibration week Mon 05/15 - Fri 05/19. Exec packet out Tue 05/23. Buffer requests for exec packet only considered for critical teams with prior approval.
hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: self-assessment due in 4 days. Link: https://redwood.company/hr/self-assess
Mei (HRBP): Clarify converted contractors: cutoff date for inclusion?
Elena (People Ops): Converted contractors included if conversion effective <= 04/10. Later converts deferred to next cycle unless exception submitted.
Jordan (IC): For managers who want to run team-level pre-calibration syncs, is there a suggested agenda? Want to keep them ~30 min.
Elena (People Ops): Suggested 30-min agenda: 1) quick alignment on rubric interpretation (5 min), 2) highlight binders for promo/comp-impact cases (10 min), 3) agree on final adjustments and capture context blurbs (10 min), 4) confirm packet owner and backup (5 min).
Ravi (Eng Manager): Where do we upload packets? Link please.
Elena (People Ops): Upload here: https://redwood.company/hr/review-packets. Packet template will be attached to the upload page.
Priya (Comp Ops): Small ask: mark any "promotion pending" rows in the packet with tag PROMO so comp ops filter can pick them up.
Elena (People Ops): Will do. Also adding a single-line "payroll impact" column to the template per Priya's ask.
hr-bot: Exception form: https://redwood.company/hr/exceptions  confirmation IDs auto-generated.
Mei (HRBP): One more: appeals window and payroll cutoff so managers can advise ICs.
Elena (People Ops): Appeals must start within 10 business days after finalized ratings. Payroll cutoff for retro changes is Fri 06/07 17:00 PT. Retro approvals will apply in the next payroll run.
Ravi (Eng Manager): Thanks. I'll push the manager checklist in leads sync and ask for backups to be set by EOD Wed.
Elena (People Ops): Thanks everyone  I'll publish the one-pager, the short template examples, and the manager checklist in handbook and DM a redacted sample packet to anyone who asks. Ping me for urgent exceptions.
